title: Input OTP
description: Six boxes for a code that arrives somewhere else — typed, pasted, or autofilled as one.
a11y: Each digit is a labelled numeric input; the first supports one-time-code autocomplete. Digits stay left-to-right inside RTL pages. Typing advances, Backspace clears and moves back, Left/Right move visually, and paste/autofill distributes digits within one instance. IME composition is guarded. A completed changed code emits a bubbling change on the group.
